text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the stands were entertained by the 
showdown between the odd-couple duo of 
Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the waiting room, Hishi Akebono and 
Biko Pegasus were exchanging a passionate 
handshake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having tuned her body to perfection, what 
kind of run will Hishi Akebono show us? 
The curtain rises on the Sprinters Stakes!
